description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Boros Garrison.
Activate Boros Garrison by tapping it, adding {R}{W}.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
